name: research-console
description: Research assistant for crawling public sources, extracting structured content, and producing concise summaries.

examples.title: Summarize a webpage
examples.prompt: Fetch a public article, extract the main content, and return a concise summary with key takeaways.

examples.title: Research a source set
examples.prompt: Crawl a small set of public pages, convert useful documents, extract tables where relevant, and produce a structured research brief.
